_doc: Investment-cost model for tprm_v1: what each vendor-risk playbook costs to run. Covers every playbook in config/playbooks/tprm_v1.json. Every figure is ASSUMED and carries its basis; sources are listed once under _sources. The hourly figure is a vendor-risk analyst's loaded cost (the key is named csm_hourly_cost because the platform uses one name for 'the person who does the work' in every vertical). No health-point lift is estimated, so no cost per health point is shown until measured lifts exist. Cost is reported beside exposure (roi.exposure), never divided into it.

csm_hourly_cost.basis: assumed: loaded hourly cost of a vendor-risk analyst. Median wage $56.41/hour divided by (1 - 0.297 benefits share) = $80.24, rounded.

hourly_cost.claim: Financial Risk Specialists (SOC 13-2054) US median $56.41/hour, $117,330/year, 2025 BLS OEWS data
Benefits were 29.7% of private-industry compensation, March 2025

playbook_hours.claim: 12+ hours for an annual vendor due-diligence review
60% say assessments take four months or longer end to end (elapsed, not effort)
4-8+ hours per vendor (Prevalent case studies); 15.23 hours per incident-triggered assessment (survey, secondary)

estimated_csm_hours.basis: assumed: Assumed. Anchored on published effort per vendor review: 4-8+ hours per assessment (vendor case studies), 12+ hours for an annual due-diligence review, about 15 hours for an incident-triggered assessment. No published per-playbook figures exist.

estimated_cost_per_execution.basis: assumed: estimated hours (assumed) x hourly cost (assumed); both links assumed, so the product is assumed

estimated_health_point_lift_per_executio.basis: assumed: no figure given. No published health-point lift exists for vendor-risk actions and no tenant has five closed instances yet.
estimated_health_point_lift_per_executio.note: no lift estimate for this playbook yet; cost per health point appears once five closed instances carry a measured lift
